FN-EGPI99C-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 77
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/09/2024
Senate Bill 77 as introduced would, effective June 1, 2024, restructure the composition of the
Alabama Department of Archives and History's Board of Trustees by: (1) including on the board
only the Governor and eight at-large members (a decrease of eight members); and (2) changing
the appointing authorities. This could decrease the obligations of the Department to reimburse
per diem and travel expenses of board members by an estimated $176 per member per board
meeting attended in person. However, according to the Department, historically board member
per diem and travel expenses have never been claimed.
Page 1

FN-EGPI99C-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 77
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/13/2024
Senate Bill 77 as reported by the Committee on County and Municipal Government would,
effective June 1, 2024, restructure the composition of the Alabama Department of Archives and
History's Board of Trustees by: (1) including on the board only the Governor and twelve at-large
members (a decrease of four members); and (2) changing the appointing authorities. This could
decrease the obligations of the Department to reimburse per diem and travel expenses of board
members by an estimated $176 per member per board meeting attended in person. However,
according to the Department, historically board member per diem and travel expenses have
never been claimed.
Page 1

FN-EGPI99C-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 77
Committee: Boards, Agencies, and Commissions Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/19/2024
Senate Bill 77 as passed the Senate could increase the obligations of the Department of
Archives and History by an estimated $353 per board meeting to reimburse the per diem and
travel expenses of the two additional members appointed to the department's board of trustees
pursuant to this bill. However, historically, board members have not claimed per diem and travel
expenses, according to the department.

FN-EGPI99C-4
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 77
Committee: Boards, Agencies, and Commissions Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/28/2024
Senate Bill 77 as reported by the Committee on Boards, Agencies, and Commissions could
increase the obligations of the Department of Archives and History by an estimated $706 per
board meeting to reimburse the per diem and travel expenses of the four additional members
appointed to the department's board of trustees pursuant to this bill. However, historically, board
members have not claimed per diem and travel expenses, according to the department.
